qs.q: Which upper gastrointestinal bleeding cause is a severe form of a Mallory-Weiss tear and is usually lethal?
qs.e: Boerhaave syndrome is the severe, usually lethal form of a Mallory-Weiss tear involving transmural esophageal rupture. Dieulafoy's lesion involves a submucosal dilated arterial vessel that bleeds massively.
